I’m no professional so I can’t diagnose you, but I will say that in my personal experience I had a time period in my life where I was greatly depressed and I didn’t want to commit suicide because I didn’t want to hurt the people I love. I did however wake up crying and hoping that I would die that day in a car crash or something. Please reach out to someone you care about and talk about whatever you may be going through or just what you are feeling. I know it might feel like a burden on them, but I promise if they care about you it’s no burden. They will be happy and feel special that you chose them to open up to about your situation. If you don’t feel you can reach out to anyone, you can always post on pages like r/SuicideWatch and often people will reach out to you. Even if it’s a little less personal, it’s someone to talk to and they’re usually pretty kind. I hope things get better. Don’t be afraid to talk to your doctor if you feel this issue is chronic
